desc: 一键蒸汽速煮七枚蛋，熟度可控不看火，配件全齐好收纳易清洗
name: 一键迷你多功能煮蛋器款

shots.intent: 第一眼建立形态与容量认知：透明穹顶七枚蛋加工作灯
唤起痛点：明火煮蛋要盯表、易溢锅过熟，为一键免看火做铺垫
速度 USP：顶拍餐桌 flat-lay，七蛋托盘居中加秒表涂鸦
易用性证据：手指按下唯一按键，插电按一下就开煮
熟度可控：量杯刻度即熟度指南，五档对应水位与蛋黄切面
配件齐全：五件套一字排开逐件标注，煮蛋之外样样都行
效果想象：穹顶内蛋饼蒸腾加四周成品食材，四种熟度一次到位
紧凑卖点：置入橱柜加尺寸标注线，配件收纳机内不占地
易清洁承诺：配件直接进洗碗机，收尾零负担
转化收尾：健康早餐加多色可选的送礼氛围完成情感闭环

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: bright high-key American kitchen e-commerce for a mini electric egg cooker. Every shot sits on a white marble counter #EDEDEA to #F4F4F2 or seamless studio white #FFFFFF, backed by soft white subway tile, with organic curved color blocks in mint #CBE5DC and #DDEBE6, butter #F7EBC3 and blush #F9DFD8 hosting all copy so text never crowds the product. Lighting is always top softbox, soft and even, with faint contact shadows and a fresh food-editorial feel; only the dishwasher trust shot may run neutral-cool stainless. The appliance keeps its exact silhouette - clear dome lid, three-footed glossy base in black #1E1E1E or pastel variants, a single silver button and a lit indicator - always shown powered on with eggs loaded. Rounded geometric all-caps red #E2231A headlines, dark green #1F3B36 body, red handwritten accents; infographics use vertical scale bars, circular yolk icons graded #F0A32E to #F5D77A, thin 1px red leader lines and hand-drawn doodles. One USP per frame; strip all brand marks, never show other-brand appliances, never fabricate awards or minute-level timing data.

red never as a large background
